paper_title: Understanding the Response to Open-Source Dependency Abandonment in the npm Ecosystem

selection.note: mineru key is unreliable; blocks are selected by title/body/inheritance. rescued_from_other counts sections labeled other but treated as typed roles.

claims.statement: Abandonment is common among widely-used npm packages, with 15% becoming abandoned within the six-year observation window.
claims.evidence_quote: 15% of widely-used packages becoming abandoned within our sixyear observation window.

claims.statement: Most exposed projects do not remove abandoned dependencies; only 18% of directly exposed projects remove the abandoned dependency.
claims.evidence_quote: 18% of exposed projects remove the abandoned dependency
